selection_boundary: Operating policy selected before calculating these client quarterly revenue totals or any updated equity value. Root floated a different seasonal example; this owned policy uses round recovery increments and is not fitted to an annual target.

Q4_2026_anchor.classification: Existing analyst estimate, CCPG Q3 revenue times 0.75; company guided a greater-than-20% sequential decline, not this exact amount. Other CCPG held at Q3 residual.

reasons: Q1: seasonal decline and continued OEM inventory correction described by CFO. Five percent is a modest analyst decline allowance from an already depressed Q4, not guidance.
Q2: assume destocking wanes after Q1 and a 10% unit rebound; this is a normalization allowance, not measured inventory replenishment.
Q3: 15% seasonal/product-launch recovery after weak H1. Nova Lake and better availability provide upside; neither disclosed accepted orders nor current PC demand establish this exact increment.

Q4: 5% additional units, below Q3 rebound because replacement pull-forward, component inflation and market contraction limit acceleration. No second 10–15% recovery increment assumed without evidence.

ASP: flat Q1 then 1% per quarter. Newer mix and price pass-through support modest increases, while larger retail memory bills and AMD/Arm competition constrain CPU pricing. PC-system ASP growth is not imported into Intel CPU ASP.

slower_2027_QoQ.reason: Longer destocking, weak end demand, limited post-Q3 recovery; no automatic catchup.

preferred_2028_2030_annual.reason: Retain the prior modest recovery assumptions on a reset 2027 level; not a forecast sourced from market research. Do not mechanically restore missed 2027 revenue.

Other_CCPG_policy.classification: Retain prior 5% 2027 and 8% later growth for isolation; equal quarter weights are bookkeeping, not timing evidence.

historical_normalization.boundary: Neutral level calibration, not observed. Quarterly and YTD year-over-year ASP growth alone do not identify Q4 versus the 2026 annual weighted ASP. Sequential forecast dollars do not depend on this calibration.

old_2027_control.use: Hold old annual target as favorable recovery diagnostic. With chosen preferred H1 and ASP path, solve required H2 unit multiplier. This reverse hurdle is not independent proof or preferred forecast.
